name: ProductReviewSection
description: Full PDP review section with aggregate rating, star distribution, filters, sorting, review cards, and progressive disclosure.

title.description: Visible section heading and accessible label.

reviewCount.description: Authoritative total review count displayed in the heading and summary.

mobileTitleSize.description: Shared heading below 1024px: 20px normal (400), or 16px Chinese 600 / English 500 resolved from lang. Desktop typography is unchanged.

averageRating.description: Aggregate five-point rating, clamped to the supported range.

ratingDistribution.description: Percentage and optional count for each rating row. Missing rows resolve to zero.

reviews.description: Review records available to local filtering, sorting, and progressive disclosure.

copy.description: Localized labels for every control, state, and review metadata field.

sortOptions.description: Single-select sort menu options with optional local comparators.

initialVisibleCount.description: Initial number of filtered reviews displayed.

viewMoreIncrement.description: Number of additional reviews revealed per View more action.

onWriteReview.description: Reports activation of the Write a review action.

focus.note: Shared buttons, chips, and sort menu retain token-backed focus states.

radius.note: Summary, review cards, tags, avatars, and meters use semantic radius tokens.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Labelled review region with accessible rating image, five meter rows, shared filters, and a single-select sort menu.
accessibility.structure: The heading labels the section; every review is an article within a responsive grid.
accessibility.interaction: Filters and progressive disclosure update visible reviews without removing native focus behavior.
